name: Protect a chat AI agent with jailbreak, PII and secret key guardrails
description: A streaming chat AI agent wrapped in two layers of guardrails. The first blocks jailbreak and prompt-injection attempts, off-topic requests and custom regex matches. The second masks personal data, secret keys, blocked keywords and URLs in both the user's message and the agent's answer.
shortDescription: A chat AI agent that blocks jailbreaks and off-topic requests and masks PII and secrets.
keyFeatures: Jailbreak and topical alignment checks judged by OpenAI, plus a custom regex check
Sanitizers for personal data, secret keys, keywords and URLs, run by Gemini
Guardrails applied to both the input and the output
Streaming answers from a Groq model with chat memory
prerequisites: Groq API key for the agent's model
OpenAI API key for the violation checks
Google Gemini API key for the sanitizers
The allowed topic, regex patterns and blocked keywords set in their guardrail elements
idealFor: Teams putting a chat assistant in front of customers or employees who need it to resist prompt injection and never repeat personal data or secrets.
steps: AI Agent: runs the violation checks and sanitizers on the message, answers with Groq and streams the reply, sanitizing the answer on the way out.
